name: 局部方差图
description: 分析 the spatial 分布 of local intensity 方差. AI images tend to have more uniform 方差 分布s 跨 the image.
mechanism: Computes 方差 in local blocks and 分析 分布. AI images show less natural variation文本中的ure complexity.
parameters: 块大小: 16x16, Metric: 系数 of variation
useCase: Detecting uniform 方差 模式 in AI生成的 content

references.title: Mahdian, B. & Saic, S. (2009). Using Noise Inconsistencies for Blind Image Forensics. Image and Vision Computing.
Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005). Exposing Digital Forgeries in Color Filter Array Interpolated Images. IEEE TSP.
Pan, X. et al. (2011). Region Duplication Detection Using Image Feature Matching. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Simple and intuitive noise characterization
• Reveals spatial noise 不一致
• Fast sliding-window computation
• Effective for detecting spliced regions
• Complementary to frequency-domain noise 分析
limitations:
• Cannot distinguish noise source types
• Textured regions naturally have high 方差
• Window size selection affects spatial 分辨率
• Sensitive to image content edges and textures
• Post-processing homogenizes 方差 模式
